title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Migrate finance and operations environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
description: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.
